To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
chrysin based sulfonylpiperazine derivatives 7a−k were successfully synthesized and evaluated for their in vitro antioxidant and cytotoxic activities.
the chrysin‐based piperazines were synthesized and evaluated as antioxidant and anticancer agents.
chrysin derivatives with sulfonylpiperazine moieties exhibited promising antioxidant and anticancer properties.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the synthesis of new sulfonylpiperazine derivatives based on flavone as potential antioxidants and anticancer agents.
the synthesis, characterization, antioxidant and cytotoxic activities of a new class of chrysin‐based derivatives.
the synthesis and biological evaluation of a series of chrysin‐based derivatives as potential free‐radical scavengers and anticancer agents.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the synthesized compounds 7a‐l exhibited promising antioxidant and anticancer activities.
the synthesized compounds have a potential role in the treatment of cancer and free radical scavengers.
the new synthesized derivatives 7a, 7d, 7e, 7g and 7h showed the highest antioxidant and anticancer activity.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the synthesized compounds 7a‐l are promising candidates for the development of novel anticancer drugs.
the synthesized chrysin‐based compounds 7a‐j were found to have better antioxidant potential than previously studied chalcone‐based derivatives.
chrysin derivatives with sulfonylpiperazine moiety can be considered as a promising class of antioxidant and anticancer agents.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the chrysin‐based piperazine sulfonyl derivatives are promising candidates for the treatment of cancer.
the sulfonylpiperazine moiety is a promising pharmacophore for the synthesis of new antioxidant and anticancer agents.
the new compounds 7a‐j are promising candidates for the design of new drugs for cancer therapy.
